title: Landfills and wastewater
description: Cut the methane rotting waste gives off: capture landfill gas, compost or digest food and garden waste, and treat sewage. The lever acts on the waste methane that the food levers leave.

landfills.title: Landfills
landfills.description: Gas collected at landfills and burnt, and organic waste composted or digested rather than buried. At 100%, about 70% of landfill methane goes. Capture acts at once; waste already buried keeps rotting for decades.

wastewater.title: Wastewater
wastewater.description: Sewers and treatment plants in place of latrines, septic tanks and raw sewage, and the gas of sludge and lagoons burnt. At 100%, about 45% of wastewater's methane goes.
